name: KIET Group of Institutions
description: Large private engineering campus on the Delhi-Meerut road (NH-58/NH-34), the anchor landmark of the Muradnagar student belt. Also listed separately as KIET Deemed To Be University.

name: KIET Temple
description: Temple inside the KIET campus with Saraswati, Radha-Krishna, Durga, Shiva and Hanuman idols. Open 5 AM to 9 PM.

name: Chhota Haridwar
description: The Upper Ganga Canal ghat on NH-58, open 24 hours. Used for holy dips and last rites, busiest during festivals. Locally called Choti Ganga.

name: Shiv Mandir, Ganga Nahar Ghat
description: Canal-side Shiv temple right at the Chhota Haridwar ghat. Early morning is the least crowded time; parking is tight.

name: Garh Ganga Canal Mod
description: The bend on the Upper Ganga Canal right bank just past Chhota Haridwar. Heavy traffic at peak hours and not recommended after dark.

name: Shri Khatu Shyam Mandir
description: Known locally as the 'bada mandir'. Open 5 AM-12 PM and 4-9 PM.

name: Hanuman Mandir Duhai
description: Roadside Hanuman temple on NH-58 near Duhai, very busy on Tuesdays with bhandaras. One of the highest-rated places of worship in the area.

name: Balaji Mandir Muradnagar
description: Small, clean neighbourhood temple in Brij Vihar Colony. No parking - come on foot or by public transport.

name: Mahadev Mandir Ordnance Factory
description: Quiet Shiva temple inside the Ordnance Factory estate, surrounded by trees and open space.

name: Drizzling Land Water and Amusement Park
description: Water and amusement park on the Delhi-Meerut Highway at Duhai, right by the Duhai RRTS station. Standard weekend outing for KIET and nearby colleges.

name: Rashtriya Ekta Park
description: Municipal garden near Jheel Masjid in Malik Nagar, open 24 hours.

name: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Park
description: Granite-paved statue park next to the Muradnagar bus stand, with an elephant sculpture section. Open 6 AM-7 PM.

name: Gandhi Park
description: Clean park inside the Ordnance Factory estate, used for morning yoga and walks. Durga Puja is held here.

name: Old Type 3 Park
description: Open-access park in the Ordnance Factory area with a playing field next to it. Locals recommend 6-7 AM for sunrise.

name: Aggarwal Restaurant
description: Pure-veg North Indian place directly opposite KIET, best known among students for a full buffet-style meal at around Rs 150. Open 9:45 AM-10:45 PM.

name: PAKWAAN Restaurant
description: Long-running restaurant on NH-58 near KIET, regularly recommended for its masala dosa. Also used for small party bookings. Open 10:30 AM-10:30 PM.

name: Khokha
description: Small evening-only cafe near pillar no. 846 by KIET, open 4-11 PM. One of the highest-rated spots right outside campus.

name: The Big Bite Co.
description: Budget cafe at pillar no. 847 next to KIET. Open 10 AM-11 PM; food can take 30 minutes at peak.

name: Cafe Slice
description: Pizza-and-shakes cafe on NH-58 by KIET. Allows birthday bookings with no venue charge beyond the order.

name: Broski Cafe and Restaurant
description: Small cafe in Friends Colony directly opposite the KIET gate.

name: SPARTA Foods
description: Non-veg counter opposite KIET beside the Axis Bank ATM - biryani, chicken momos, roomali roti. Closed Tuesdays.

name: Big Treat
description: Snack shop inside the KIET campus behind Tagore hostel. Burgers, maggi, patties, tea and coffee at hostel prices; open till 2 AM.

name: Two Hearts Cafe
description: Budget cafe in Shivam Vihar Colony near KIET, open noon to midnight. Known for noodles, momos and spring rolls.

name: UP 14 Restaurant & Food Point
description: Indian-Chinese restaurant in Radhey Shyam Vihar near KIET, open till 12:30 AM most nights.

name: Flavours Food
description: Multi-cuisine first-floor place near the IGL CNG pump at pillar no. 834, Asalat Nagar. Wide menu, service can be slow.

name: Tandoori Gali
description: Tandoori chicken and paratha counter on the Delhi-Meerut road near KIET. Open 3-11 PM, closed Tuesdays.

name: S Cafe
description: Pizza and Chinese cafe on Railway Road opposite Priya Cinema - one of the highest-rated eateries in Muradnagar town. Open 11 AM-10:30 PM.

name: Son Of Swaad (Baap of Chaap)
description: Soya chaap specialist on Railway Road near the police chowki. Open 11:30 AM-11:30 PM.

name: Zorko Brand Of Food Lovers
description: Cafe near Vishal Mega Mart in Brij Vihar Colony, opposite ICICI Bank. Open 11 AM-11 PM.

name: GOG Cafe & Bakers
description: Cafe and bakery in Shivam Vihar, Asalat Nagar - cakes, pastries and Chinese. Open 12:30-11 PM.

name: Yadav Family Dhaba
description: Veg dhaba on Muradnagar Main Road at Vijay Mandi, open 7 AM to midnight. Known for chole bhature thali and kulhad kheer.

name: Jhilmil Dhaba Muradnagar
description: Highway stop on NH-58 near the Ganga canal, open 10 AM-midnight. Best known for dry-fruit kulfi; food is on the pricey side for a dhaba.

name: Shan E Punjab Muradnagar
description: Roadside restaurant on the Meerut-Delhi road opposite Abupur gate, open 6 AM-11 PM. Ample parking, kulhad chai.

name: Marwadi Swad
description: Sattvik (no onion-garlic) thali stop on NH-34 near the Ganga canal. Unlimited thali, open 8 AM-11 PM.

name: Deepak Dhaba
description: 24-hour dhaba opposite Manota Gate on the Delhi-Meerut Expressway.

name: Jain Sweets & Confectionery
description: Established sweet shop at pillar no. 889 near the RRTS line - samosas, rasgulla, malai chaap. Open 8 AM-9:30 PM.

name: Vrinda Sweets
description: Sweet shop near the Reliance Trends showroom on the Delhi-Meerut road. Locals point here for the best samosa in town.

name: Umanng Sweets & Restaurant
description: Newer sweets-and-restaurant outlet at pillar no. 903 opposite Domino's, noted for cleanliness and pav bhaji.

name: Rupa Halwai's Muradnagar
description: Old-name halwai at pillar no. 913 near the RRTS station, Ambedkar Park. Kalakand and malai burfi are the specialities.

name: Gol Market
description: Circular market serving the Ordnance Factory estate - groceries, stationery, medicines, clothing, sweets. Open 6 AM-10 PM.

name: Chaman Market
description: Market on Muradnagar Main Road at Vijay Mandi, the go-to for stationery (wholesale and retail), plus clothes, groceries and a cyber cafe.

name: Fouji Market
description: Small local market in Ward 3, open 8 AM-8 PM.

name: S R Super Store
description: The main grocery store on Muradnagar Main Road. Offers a standing discount; very crowded on Sundays and holidays.

name: Muradnagar RRTS Station (Namo Bharat)
description: Namo Bharat rapid rail station on the Delhi-Meerut corridor - the fastest link from Muradnagar to Anand Vihar, Ghaziabad and Meerut.

name: Muradnagar Railway Station
description: Small Indian Railways station in New Defence Colony on the Delhi-Meerut line, with a handful of express and passenger trains daily.

name: Duhai RRTS Station
description: Namo Bharat station at Duhai, the closest RRTS stop to the Duhai college cluster and Drizzling Land.

name: Duhai Depot Station
description: RRTS depot station and stabling yard at Basantpur Saitli - the place to actually see Namo Bharat trains parked and tested.

name: Modi Mandir (Shri Laxmi Narayan Temple)
description: Modinagar's defining landmark, built in 1963 by Rai Bahadur Gujar Mal Modi. Large gardens, lotus ponds and ducks; hosts Ramleela and community events. Open 5-9 AM and 5-9 PM.

name: Modinagar Kali Mandir
description: Temple at Modi Park on NH-58 with large lawns and parking. Extremely crowded during Navratri.

name: Shri Ram Temple Sasaram
description: Old temple in Harmukhpuri, Govindpuri, set among banyan and banana trees. Open 5-11 AM and 4:30-8 PM.

name: Modi Sugar Mill & Distillery
description: The working Modi industrial complex the town grew around, near Modinagar Railway Station. An active factory, not a heritage site - no visitor access.

name: SOUTHALL Restaurant
description: South Indian restaurant on Meerut Road opposite the RapidX station, Lower Bazar. Among the highest-rated eateries in Modinagar. Open 11:30 AM-10:30 PM.

name: Lalaji's Restaurant
description: Pure-veg restaurant on NH-34 at Sikri Kalan with large parking and banquet halls. Open 11 AM-11 PM.

name: Sky Cafe
description: Cafe in Impala Tower on NH-58 opposite the sugar mill karamchari gate. Open 11 AM-10:30 PM, later on Sundays.

name: The Ethnic Cuisine
description: First-floor restaurant in Sanjeevni Estate, Sikri Khurd - one of the few places in Modinagar serving late. Closed Tuesdays.

name: Raja Sweets
description: Sweets-and-snacks counter next to Modi Mandir, known for chole bhature. Small seating, usually crowded.

name: Hatke Chaap Dhaba
description: Veg chaap specialist on NH-58 at Kadrabad, opposite Prachin Shiv Mandir. Open noon-11:30 PM; small dining area.

name: Rukmani Market
description: Modinagar's main clothing and fashion market near the railway station - suits, dupattas, jewellery, cosmetics and a fruit market. Parking is a real problem.

name: Bhagwan Ganj Mandi
description: The grain and wholesale trading hub of Modinagar near the Tibra Road railway crossing. Closed Tuesdays.

name: Indira Market
description: Market known for mobile accessories, computers and fast food. Open 8 AM-9 PM.

name: Main Market Govindpuri
description: Crowded, cheap market in Govindpuri. Closed Fridays; Thursday is the recommended day.

name: Modinagar Railway Station
description: Station on the Delhi-Meerut line, walking distance from the bus stand and GT Road.

name: Modinagar South RRTS Station
description: Elevated Namo Bharat station opened March 2024, serving south Modinagar and nearby institutions.

name: Dasna Devi Mandir
description: Ancient Kali temple at Dasna on the Delhi-Meerut route with a sarovar. Carry ID; security is tight. Open 9:30 AM-8 PM.

name: City Forest Park Ghaziabad
description: Large park on the Hindon bank with walking and cycle trails, two lakes with boating, horse and jeep rides. Small entry fee; open 7 AM-8 PM.

name: Kavi Nagar Ramleela Maidan
description: The city's long-running Ramleela and Dussehra ground in Kavi Nagar, with a large mela of food and shopping stalls during Navratri.

name: ABES Engineering College
description: Large private engineering campus at Dundahera on the NH-9 side of Ghaziabad.

name: Shipra Mall
description: The anchor mall of Vaibhav Khand, Indirapuram, and the default weekend meeting point for the area.

name: Shri Laxmi Narayan Temple Vasundhara
description: Neighbourhood temple at Nandan Park, Sector 3 Vasundhara, known for large Janmashtami celebrations. Open 5 AM-9 PM.

name: Sachdeva Chicken Corner RDC
description: The well-known RDC non-veg counter near Hint Chowk on Ashok Marg - tandoori and tawa chicken, mutton rice. Takeaway only, no seating. Open 4-10:30 PM, closed Tuesdays.

name: Biryani By Kilo RDC
description: Dum biryani and kebab restaurant opposite Gaur Mall in Raj Nagar District Centre. Open 10 AM-midnight.

name: Haldiram's World Square Mall
description: Sweets and family dining inside World Square Mall right by Mohan Nagar metro. Open 10 AM-11 PM.

name: R K Sweets Arthala
description: Mohan Nagar sweet shop in Arthala known locally for its samosas and ghewar. Open 7 AM-10 PM.

name: Mama Chicken Mama Franky House Indirapuram
description: Branch of the Agra chain in Express Garden Market, Vaibhav Khand - tandoori chicken, kebabs and frankies.

name: Bikanervala Muradnagar
description: Well-known family restaurant for North Indian snacks, chole bhature, sweets, and thalis.

name: KIET Back Gate Maggi & Chai Point
description: Popular student hangout outside KIET campus known for cheese butter maggi and hot ginger tea.

name: Mohan Nagar Temple (Durga Mandir)
description: Iconic and historic Hindu temple dedicated to Goddess Durga in Mohan Nagar, Ghaziabad.

name: Hauz Khas Social & Deer Park
description: Historic water reservoir lake surrounded by ruins, cafes, and deer park walking trails in South Delhi.
